summary: Lower general JavaScript division through a semantics helper when coercion or BigInt is possible.

target.notes: Apply ToNumeric to both operands and require matching Number/BigInt numeric kinds; BigInt division truncates toward zero and division by 0n throws RangeError.

semantics.evaluation_order: left expression, right expression, then required coercions in specification order
semantics.coercion: Apply ToNumeric to both operands and require matching Number/BigInt numeric kinds; BigInt division truncates toward zero and division by 0n throws RangeError.
semantics.result_type: Number or BigInt, except addition may also return String

caveats: Object coercion may invoke user-defined valueOf/toString/Symbol.toPrimitive with side effects or exceptions.
Symbol operands can make numeric/string coercion throw TypeError.
